end.summary:
- Practised drawing triangular and square-number dot pictures.
- Described triangular growth as adding a new row.
- Used rows, columns, and the corner to explain square-number growth.
- Explained why the corner is counted twice and why the next L-shape adds an odd number.
- Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised using dot pictures to show how triangular and square sequences grow. Ishita explained the corner double-counting idea clearly and connected a 4×4 square to an added L-shape of 9 dots. There was an initial mix-up about the number of added dots, and Ishita corrected the counting later by separating the two sides and the shared corner. At home, ask Ishita to draw the next two square-number pictures and label the new L-shape dots.
